# A request for a directory of the static assets is a 404 unless the
# directory holds an index.html; the embedded files are never listed.

muxt generate --input-static-assets-directory=assets --output-static-assets-path=/static --use-receiver-type=Server
exec go test -count=1

-- go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}
-- assets/app.css --
p{color:red}
-- assets/plain/data.txt --
data
-- assets/site/index.html --
<h1>site</h1>
-- index.gohtml --
{{define "GET / Index()"}}home{{end}}
-- server.go --
package server

func (Server) Index() string { return "" }
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestStaticAssetsNoListing(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	// ServeMux redirects a path it would clean, so these never reach the
	// handler through it; mounted another way they must not read a
	// different directory than the file server would.
	for _, raw := range []string{"/static//plain/", "/static/./plain/", "/static/../static/plain/"} {
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/static/plain/", nil)
		req.URL.Path = raw
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if rec.Code == http.StatusOK || strings.Contains(rec.Body.String(), "<pre>") {
			t.Errorf("GET %s status = %d body = %q, want no listing", raw, rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
		}
	}
	for _, tt := range []struct {
		path   string
		status int
		body   string
	}{
		{path: "/static/", status: http.StatusNotFound},
		{path: "/static/plain/", status: http.StatusNotFound},
		{path: "/static/plain", status: http.StatusNotFound},
		{path: "/static/app.css", status: http.StatusOK, body: "p{color:red}\n"},
		{path: "/static/plain/data.txt", status: http.StatusOK, body: "data\n"},
		{path: "/static/site/", status: http.StatusOK, body: "<h1>site</h1>\n"},
		{path: "/static/missing/", status: http.StatusNotFound},
	} {
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, tt.path, nil))
		if rec.Code != tt.status {
			t.Errorf("GET %s status = %d, want %d", tt.path, rec.Code, tt.status)
		}
		if strings.Contains(rec.Body.String(), "<pre>") {
			t.Errorf("GET %s body is a directory listing: %q", tt.path, rec.Body.String())
		}
		if tt.body != "" && rec.Body.String() != tt.body {
			t.Errorf("GET %s body = %q, want %q", tt.path, rec.Body.String(), tt.body)
		}
	}
}
